extraction.Name: James Didier (appearing re: Emma Clairmont Didier, Dec'd)
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: My wife had been sick for some time before she died and I tried to do what I could for her and went to considerable expense including hospital treatment at Omaha for her. In order to pay off the obligations I sold this land.
extraction.Occupation/Income: By farming and such other work as I can get
extraction.NOTES: Allottee of record is Emma Clairmont (Didier), deceased, allotment no. 701; James Didier is her surviving husband and deponent; Emma died January 20, 1920; patent in fee was issued for her allotment after she died; estate probated in county court at White River; heirs found to be Louise, William, James Jr., Gilbert, and James Didier; all heirs still living; Gilbert stays with Harry Iron Wing; sale price was $2000.00 — $1600 cash and the remainder in horses; document notarized by Wo Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32; sworn June 7, 1929
